decision: No isolated package-lock, constraints override, forced resolver input, or baseline-pin replacement was built. Current official inputs cannot yield a clean SEC-DEPS-01 result; manufacturing such a candidate would be unsupported and would not meet the gate.

frappe.comparison: All listed hashes are identical between the baseline and v16.34.0. The newer release continues to require pypdf==6.15.0, WeasyPrint==68.0, and pdfkit~=1.0.0.

erpnext.comparison: All listed hashes are identical between the baseline and v16.35.0.

education.comparison: All listed hashes are identical between the released baseline and the unselected official version-16 branch head. A moving branch is not substituted for a release.

hrms.comparison: No newer non-prerelease v16 release was listed.

python_remediation_blockers.blocker: Frappe v16.34.0 continues to require pdfkit~=1.0.0 and the advisory lists no patched release.
Frappe v16.34.0 continues to pin pypdf==6.15.0.
Frappe v16.34.0 continues to pin WeasyPrint==68.0.
The selected official Bench v5.31.0 constraint is <82.0.0. A >=83 override would violate the reviewed upstream constraint.

node_remediation_blocker.blocker: Neither newer released Frappe/ERPNext inputs nor the unselected Education version-16 branch head changes any reviewed Node manifest or frozen lockfile. Manually changing nested locks, package resolutions, or registry inputs would not be an officially released compatible Frappe/Education bundle.

candidate_execution.reason: The official-input review proves that every evaluated source leaves known fail conditions in place before a Bench build. Running a fabricated override candidate would not meet the required clean full-stack audit and would create unsupported evidence theater.
not_claimed: Backup/restore, worker/scheduler/realtime, upgrade/restart, or browser regression qualification

smallest_viable_upstream_change: An officially released, Frappe-compatible source bundle that removes/replaces pdfkit or supplies a supported remediation for its no-fixed-version advisory.

An officially released compatible Frappe v16 dependency update with pypdf at least 6.16.1 and WeasyPrint outside all recorded affected ranges, plus a compatible official Bench release permitting setuptools at least 83.0.0 or an upstream-supported alternative.

An officially released compatible Education v16 dependency/lockfile update that removes all applicable resolved Node advisory matches; Frappe/ERPNext Node locks must also change where they carry matches.

Only after such source inputs exist: create a separate immutable candidate matrix, build a disposable Bench, require a clean full-stack audit and security gates, then run the unchanged 542 native lifecycle and all recovery/worker/scheduler/realtime/upgrade/restart/browser regressions before any baseline replacement decision.
